Ammonium lactate is standard treatment for xerosis, reinforcing this diagnosis. Antiestrogen therapy may contribute to skin dryness as a secondary factor, but it is less strongly supported. Contact dermatitis is effectively refuted by the lack of allergen exposure. The absence of dermatology examination or biopsy tempers confidence but does not change the leading diagnosis.
